horizonRewind_hold.onDown: if not extensions.horizonRewind then extensions.load('horizonRewind') end if extensions.horizonRewind then extensions.horizonRewind.beginRewind() end
horizonRewind_hold.title: Horizon Rewind: hold to rewind
horizonRewind_hold.desc: Hold to visibly rewind the player car, release to resume. History builds automatically. The normal recovery binding also works.

horizonRewind_enable.onDown: if not extensions.horizonRewind then extensions.load('horizonRewind') end if extensions.horizonRewind then extensions.horizonRewind.setEnabled(true) end
horizonRewind_enable.title: Horizon Rewind: enable live rewind
horizonRewind_enable.desc: Re-enable automatic live rewind after disabling it or an error. Normally enabled automatically in Freeroam.

horizonRewind_disable.onDown: if not extensions.horizonRewind then extensions.load('horizonRewind') end if extensions.horizonRewind then extensions.horizonRewind.setEnabled(false) end
horizonRewind_disable.title: Horizon Rewind: disable live rewind
horizonRewind_disable.desc: Stop live rewind and restore normal vehicle recovery.

horizonRewind_cancel.onDown: if not extensions.horizonRewind then extensions.load('horizonRewind') end if extensions.horizonRewind then extensions.horizonRewind.cancelRewind() end
horizonRewind_cancel.title: Horizon Rewind: cancel rewind
horizonRewind_cancel.desc: Cancel the current rewind and return to where it began.

horizonRewind_speed1.onDown: if not extensions.horizonRewind then extensions.load('horizonRewind') end if extensions.horizonRewind then extensions.horizonRewind.setSpeed(1) end
horizonRewind_speed1.title: Horizon Rewind: 1x speed
horizonRewind_speed1.desc: Set rewind playback to normal speed.

horizonRewind_speed2.onDown: if not extensions.horizonRewind then extensions.load('horizonRewind') end if extensions.horizonRewind then extensions.horizonRewind.setSpeed(2) end
horizonRewind_speed2.title: Horizon Rewind: 2x speed
horizonRewind_speed2.desc: Set rewind playback to double speed.

horizonRewind_speed4.onDown: if not extensions.horizonRewind then extensions.load('horizonRewind') end if extensions.horizonRewind then extensions.horizonRewind.setSpeed(4) end
horizonRewind_speed4.title: Horizon Rewind: 4x speed
horizonRewind_speed4.desc: Set rewind playback to quadruple speed.
